name: Mark bad data
summary: Marks bad channels and bad time segments in raw MEG/EEG data with MNE-Python, from a channel list, a BIDS channels.tsv and annotation lines, and outputs the updated raw .fif with a PSD plot.
description: Adds channels to raw.info['bads'] from the bads parameter and from rows of a channels.tsv whose status is 'bad', and adds mne.Annotations for segments given as 'onset, duration, description[, channels]' lines. Use it to record manual quality-control decisions so downstream Apps exclude those channels and segments. reset_bads clears existing bad channels first.

inputs.description: Continuous MEG/EEG data in MNE raw .fif format.
channels.tsv file (at least 2 columns: name and status). Channels with status "bad" will be rejected.

outputs.description: Raw data with added annotation with marked channel x time segments.

parameters.description: Bad data segments described by their start, duration, description, and optionally the channels they apply to (all channels if omitted).
parameters.placeholder: start, duration, description[, channels] (possibly on several lines)

parameters.description: Reset bad channels before adding new ones specified here.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, Heinsfeld AS, et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21:809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7:267 (2013).
